title: Drake Reacts To Boosie Badazz Finding Out That He Is Half Jewish [Watch]
htmlContent:

He finna get mo’ powerful! I ain’t know that!”

“Drake’s mother is Jewish. Drake had a bar mitzvah, there’s footage of it,” Vlad shared. “Remember when he did that video with Lil Wayne where he had the whole bar mitzvah music video? You may have missed it.

“I remember someone hit me up about this, who grew up around Drake. Drake was raised in a Jewish part of Toronto with his mother and his mother’s Jewish family. He wasn’t around his father; his father moved away to Memphis. He wasn’t raised with his Black family; he was raised with his Jewish family.”

After seeing the clip of Boosie on DJ Akademiks Instagram Page, The Certified Lover Boy like the post.

After Boosie realized where Vlad is taking him through his points regarding the 'Her Loss' artist, Vlad points out that he dissing Kanye West because of his anti-Semitic rhetoric.

“So how [is Kanye] shocked that you’re bashing Jews for two weeks, and the Jewish guy was like, ‘F**k you’ on his new album? How is this a surprise?”

Speaking of Boosie, he has been in a back in forth recently with Gabrielle Union.

She suggested he might be in the closet in an old interview, and then Boosie went on another rant on social media.
